text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Epiglottic entrapment is a type of 
"roaring" disease in Umamusume. Due to the 
fold in the throat, breathing becomes 
difficult during long-distance runs...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
In that case, we have no choice but to 
take the 2,000m Shuka Sho off our list of 
goals. Good luck, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Surgery requires more than half a year of 
rest— Then that's out of the question. If 
I stop for that long, so many will give up 
on their dreams, and it'll be too late!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Turnaround! Change of plans! Our next goal 
will be the Mile Championship at 1,600 
meters!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, however, Taiki contacted 
me to say she's running in the Mile CS! 
This is... quite a threat.
